_doc: [onboard] The first-minutes story objectives (story/objectives.gd, ui/objective_card.gd). One at a time, in order, each with a one-line why (desc). brief.lines: WREN's one last message in the crash (two subtitle lines), then she is silent until the Signal Tower (story/signal_tower.gd). Objective fields: text (title), desc (the why), hint (shown instead of desc until wait_flag is set), type stat|robot|zone|hub_level|flag|core|tower, key, target (absolute: lifetime stats), hex (true: outline the target hex on the ground with its % cleaned), lines (WREN, when the objective starts). Data stays English; tr() at display.

lines: Lumi, it's WREN, the Cradle's caretaker. Your friend up here. Your pod's down, and the relay's failing.
Bale junk to power the old base, then build a signal tower so I can reach you. I'll be [glitch]listen—[/glitch]

objectives.desc: Cubes feed the recycler. Its power wakes the base.
WREN went silent. The tower lets her reach you.
Clean ground is where green can grow again.
A helper keeps cleaning while you work.
lines: The base has power! Enough to build you a helper. Try the Bots tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: Press B and paint the hexes it should clean.
It carries bales to the scale for you.
Living green charges your Bloom Core.
objectives.hint: Keep clearing ground. Seeds turn up in clean soil.

objectives.desc: A bigger base runs more robots.
lines: The hub can grow now. Rebuild it from the Hub tab at the workbench.

objectives.desc: A stronger signal: WREN comes through clearer.
